source_usage: Topic labels only; explanations, figures, code, and structure are original.

articles.title: Attention from First Principles: One Complete Calculation
articles.desc: Work through queries, keys, stable softmax, masking, weighted values, gradients, and tensor shapes using a numerical example that can be reproduced.

articles.title: Token Embeddings: Just a Table Lookup
articles.desc: See how cat sat cat becomes token IDs and vectors, click tokens to trace a lookup, and learn what the embedding table does in a few lines of PyTorch.

articles.title: Feed-Forward Networks: Expansion, Nonlinearity, and Gates
articles.desc: Derive the position-wise MLP, understand why its nonlinear expansion matters, and compare GELU and SwiGLU at matched parameter budgets.

articles.title: LayerNorm, RMSNorm, and Residual Scale
articles.desc: Compute normalization by hand, distinguish feature-wise statistics from batch statistics, and derive what pre-norm residual paths do and do not guarantee.

articles.title: A Transformer Block, Line by Line
articles.desc: Trace a pre-norm block through attention, residual addition, normalization, and an MLP, with shapes, parameter counts, and causal correctness conditions.

articles.title: Dropout: What Is Random, What Is Preserved
articles.desc: Derive inverted dropout, distinguish activation and attention dropout, and understand expectation, variance, evaluation mode, and reproducibility.

articles.title: Multi-Head Attention: Separate Reads, One Residual Update
articles.desc: Follow split, attend, concatenate, and project with exact shapes; understand what extra heads change and what they do not guarantee.

articles.title: Position Encodings: Order Must Enter Somewhere
articles.desc: Derive why attention is permutation equivariant, compute sinusoidal positions, and compare additive absolute encodings with relative attention mechanisms.

articles.title: Causal Attention: The Information Boundary
articles.desc: Derive the causal mask from next-token likelihood, implement offset masks for cached decoding, and test that future tokens cannot change earlier outputs.

articles.title: Cross-Attention: Queries Read a Different Sequence
articles.desc: Trace a rectangular attention matrix, source/target dimensions, encoder–decoder conditioning, multimodal inputs, and reusable source caches.

articles.title: MHA, MQA, and GQA: Sharing the KV Cache
articles.desc: Derive query-to-KV grouping, cache bytes, projection counts, and the tradeoffs between independent and shared keys and values.

articles.title: Sparse Attention: Windows, Global Tokens, and Information Paths
articles.desc: Compare local, global, dilated, and block patterns as graphs; derive their edge counts and receptive fields without confusing a dense mask with a sparse kernel.

articles.title: Linear Attention: From Pairwise Reads to a Recurrent State
articles.desc: Derive normalized kernel attention, its parallel and recurrent forms, state dimensions, and why reassociation does not preserve ordinary softmax attention.

articles.title: DeltaNet: Write the Error, Not Another Copy
articles.desc: Derive the delta-rule state update as gradient descent on an association, analyze overwrite behavior and key interference, and connect recurrence to chunkwise training.

articles.title: Gated DeltaNet: Forget Globally, Update Selectively
articles.desc: Separate state decay from delta-rule learning, derive the order of operations, and measure retention over time with a controlled example.

articles.title: Kimi Delta Attention: Channel-Wise Memory Control
articles.desc: Derive KDA from a diagonal forget gate and a delta update, inspect noncommuting transitions, and distinguish the recurrent core from a complete KDA layer.

articles.title: RoPE: Relative Position Through Rotated Queries and Keys
articles.desc: Derive the relative-position identity for rotary embeddings, compute a two-dimensional example, and understand frequency schedules, caching, and length extension.

articles.title: ALiBi: A Distance Bias in Attention Logits
articles.desc: Derive causal linear position biases, calculate their effect on probability ratios, and separate recency preference from content matching and length generalization.

articles.title: Multi-Head Latent Attention: Derive the Compressed Cache
articles.desc: Derive joint KV compression, absorb key/value projections algebraically, account for the positional cache, and distinguish latent attention from head sharing.

articles.title: FlashAttention: Exact Softmax Without the Full Matrix
articles.desc: Derive online softmax and mergeable attention statistics, work through a numerical example, and separate arithmetic, activation storage, and memory traffic.

articles.title: FlashAttention-2 and -3: From Algebra to GPU Scheduling
articles.desc: Separate online-softmax correctness from work partitioning, GPU occupancy, asynchronous pipelines, and FP8 quantization in later FlashAttention implementations.

articles.title: KV Caching: Why the Prefix Can Stay Put
articles.desc: Derive cached autoregressive decoding from causality, account for memory and per-token work, and distinguish prefill, cache reuse, and output generation.

articles.title: PagedAttention: Manage the Cache Without Moving the Sequence
articles.desc: Explain logical versus physical KV blocks, allocation waste, prefix sharing, copy-on-write, and the boundary between memory management and attention mathematics.

articles.title: Ring Attention: Distributed Reads with Online Softmax
articles.desc: Derive how local queries attend to circulating key/value shards, why per-shard outputs cannot simply be averaged, and when communication can overlap computation.

articles.title: Speculative Decoding: Draft, Verify, and Correct
articles.desc: Derive exact acceptance and residual sampling, work through a three-token distribution, and understand multi-token verification, cache rollback, and speed limits.

articles.title: Hybrid Attention: Combine Retrieval with Recurrent Memory
articles.desc: Follow the data flow and cache budget of a stack that alternates recurrent updates with token-addressable attention.

articles.title: Mixture of Experts: Conditional MLPs and the Cost of Routing
articles.desc: Derive top-k expert routing, distinguish active from total parameters, and trace dispatch, balancing, shared experts, and latent expert spaces.

articles.title: Attention Residuals: Let a Layer Choose Its Sources Across Depth
articles.desc: Understand AttnRes by replacing fixed residual accumulation with token-dependent weighting over earlier depth sources, then examine its block approximation.

articles.title: Kimi K3: Read a Modern Hybrid Model from Its Configuration
articles.desc: Connect KDA, NoPE MLA, latent MoE, and block Attention Residuals using the July 2026 report and a pinned official model configuration.

articles.title: Tokenization: How Text Becomes the Sequence a Model Learns
articles.desc: Work through BPE merges, vocabulary tradeoffs, loss denominators, whitespace, special tokens, and the boundary between tokenization and embeddings.

articles.title: Training a Transformer: Targets, Gradients, Batches, and Evaluation
articles.desc: Trace shifted next-token targets through cross-entropy, masked loss reduction, AdamW, accumulation, and held-out evaluation.

articles.title: Transformer Architectures: Choose the Information Flow
articles.desc: Compare encoder-only, decoder-only, and encoder-decoder graphs using the same source and target sequence, then separate architecture from training objective.

articles.title: The Transformer Encoder: Context, Padding, and Task Heads
articles.desc: Build an encoder graph and distinguish bidirectional representations, mask semantics, pooling, and token-level outputs.

articles.title: The Transformer Decoder: From a Prefix to the Next Token
articles.desc: Trace shifted logits, causal residual blocks, sampling, and cache updates, and distinguish decoder-only from encoder-decoder terminology.

articles.title: GPT-2 as a Starting Point: Build the Whole Language Model
articles.desc: Assemble token and position embeddings, pre-norm causal blocks, tied output weights, and next-token training; count a small GPT-2 configuration.

articles.title: BERT: Learn Bidirectional Representations by Reconstructing Tokens
articles.desc: Explain why bidirectional attention needs a reconstruction target, how the original masking policy works, and what BERT does and does not define as a generative model.

articles.title: Vision Transformers: Turn an Image into a Sequence of Patches
articles.desc: Trace patch extraction and projection, positional information, classification, resolution changes, and the cost of smaller patches.

articles.title: The Quadratic Problem: Prefill, Decode, and a Complexity Explorer
articles.desc: Count attention operations, score storage, KV bytes, and recurrent state with explicit assumptions, then explore which costs grow during prefill and decoding.

articles.title: Transformer Math Lab: Test the Identities Behind the Diagrams
articles.desc: Run small NumPy experiments for attention, causality, online softmax, recurrent updates, RoPE, MLA, and exact speculative correction.

articles.title: The Transformer Evolution Map: Compare Changes on the Right Axis
articles.desc: Organize GPT-2, efficient attention, recurrent memory, hybrid stacks, MoE, and AttnRes by what each changes, without treating every idea as a replacement for the previous one.

articles.title: Transformer Foundations: Follow the Model Diagram
articles.desc: Follow one clickable transformer diagram through all eight foundation chapters, with the current component highlighted and clear connections from token IDs to next-token predictions.

articles.title: Transformers: From the First Attention Calculation to Hybrid Language Models
articles.desc: A rebuilt learning path through Transformer foundations, GPT-2, efficient attention, recurrent memory, modern hybrids, and runnable mathematical experiments.
